fields.owner_ref: person, ship, station, department or institution owning the record
fields.effective_period: optional period summarized by the entry
fields.display_stardate: derived or authored stardate presentation; authoritative time remains the campaign timestamp

content.subjective: true for personal/opinion-bearing entries where statements are not guaranteed world truth

fields.source_refs: optional references to operational events, results, reports or other authorized records
fields.provenance: how the entry was authored, transcribed or assisted

rules: A log entry is not authoritative proof that every claim inside it is true.
Personal logs are subjective by default.
Official logs may summarize authoritative events but do not replace the underlying event records.
AI-assisted text requires the same authorization and approval as human-authored text.
Private entries are never globally visible merely because they exist.
Corrections create a new version/entry relationship rather than silently rewriting historical publication.
